text: "Juno would've preferred a war of words."
"Tell me, did that work out for her two hundred cycles ago?"
"Why don't we discuss this over a nice cup of tea?"
"Keep your tea. I'm starving, Weald."
"Killing me would only make your life harder."
"Then get out of my bloody way and let me pass!"
"Let's talk. I've had enough of fighting comrades."
"You wouldn't believe me anyway."
"I don't want to fight you. You'd wipe the floor with me."
"Wouldn't be the first time, would it?"
"Comrade, can't we settle this without ruining my moustache?"
“Shut up and fight wanker!”
"You're skin and bone. Wouldn't want you losing a hip from the next punch."
"Uh... cheers. You look bloody awful too."
"Want food? Surrender."
"Aye, that's literally what I've been asking you to do!"
"You haven't much time left. The vassals are coming darling."
"I reckon... you're just talking out your arse."
"Think on it. How many more will you have to kill to leave this house?"
"I didn't... I DIDN'T KILL ANYONE!"
"The more you attack me, the less inclined I am to believe you. You do know that, don't you?"
"Why do you think I'm still talking to you?"
"Y-you believe me? Then lower your weapon first!"
"I know you're a good person."
"...Then why won't you let me go?"
"Listen, you're hungry. I understand."
"Do you? You're looking a bit well-fed yourself..."
"Not long ago, we were friends, Lia..."
"Aye... I don't want to hurt you. Believe me."
"I can help you out of this, if you'll let me."
"HOW!? No one would believe me!"
"There's still reason in you. I can see it in your eyes."
"Are you flirting with me!? NOW!?"
"Lay down your arms. Take my bread. That's what Polyanna would say."
"Wise words from a dead woman..."
"I'd hate to spoil that pretty face of yours."
"Is that what you'll tell your comrades from six feet under?"
"Get on your knees and pray for my mercy!"
"I'd never pray to someone who smells of cock and ash."
"This time I'll beat you senseless!"
"Ha! Can't wait to spill your FUCKING blood again!"
"WE OUGHT TO SEND YOU BACK WHERE YOU CAME FROM!"
"Where? I was born in Lundonstoch, you idiot."
"You killed our children, stole our rations... what more do you want besides my fists!?"
"To see the colour drained from your face."
"Surrender NOW or I'll kick your arse clean through that window!"
"Mind your back, old man."
"My health bar's bigger than yours!"
"What!?"
"Someone's pulling your strings from the shadows. I can see them above your shoulders."
"What the fuck are you talking about."
"This isn't our battle. Be smart, Lia."
"I don't think I've much choice left, Weald."
"How about we pretend none of this ever happened, comrade?"
"Fine. No point carrying on."
"How about we pretend none of this ever happened, comrade?"
"What's the matter? Afraid you'll end up flat on your arse?"
